scope: Theorem 3.1 (Triangle mass from cross mass) of the manuscript “A logarithmic independence bound for clique-free graphs” (preprints/A-Logarithmic-Independence-Bound-for-Clique-Free-Graphs-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 184 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 15717a7c82914df2), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For every C ≥ 1 there is a constant C△(C) with the following property. If G is a finite simple graph with positive vertex weights w satisfying (3.1), then TG(w) ≤ C△(C)MG(w).
